# Gavin Boss

**Senior Analyst | M.S. Applied Business Analytics | Python • SQL • Power BI • Predictive Analytics**

I am an analytics professional with **8+ years of experience** solving complex problems, identifying meaningful patterns, and translating analysis into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers.

I completed a **Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University**, where I expanded my professional analytical background with hands-on work in **Python, SQL, Power BI, statistical modeling, machine learning, forecasting, simulation, optimization, and data visualization**.

My work focuses on turning complex data into clear insights that support better decisions, improve processes, and help organizations understand what is driving performance.

## Featured Projects

### Predictive Salary Modeling

Built and compared **generalized linear regression, polynomial regression, and Random Forest models** in Python to predict salary outcomes and evaluate the variables most strongly associated with compensation.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib  
**Methods:** Regression, Random Forest, feature importance, model evaluation

[View Project](projects.html)

### Zurich Airbnb Market Analysis

Analyzed Airbnb listing data using **regression, classification, clustering, NLP, and dimensionality reduction** to identify market patterns, customer segments, and factors associated with listing performance.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn  
**Methods:** Random Forest, K-Means, PCA, TF-IDF, regression

[View Project](projects.html)

### Risk, Simulation & Decision Optimization

Developed quantitative decision models to compare business strategies under uncertainty using **forecasting, Monte Carlo simulation, Bayesian inference, optimization, and financial decision analysis**.

Projects included:

- 50,000-path demand simulations
- 100,000-trial strategy optimization
- Bayesian probability modeling
- Net Present Value decision frameworks
- Risk-constrained resource allocation

**Tools:** Python, NumPy, SciPy  
**Methods:** Monte Carlo simulation, Bayesian analysis, forecasting, optimization

[View Project](projects.html)
